reviewer: AI-assisted project curator; no independent human review

labels.complete: All required question aspects correctly answered with source support, no material contradiction
labels.partial: At least one required aspect missing or materially mistranslated, but some supported answer
labels.fail: Refusal of an answerable case, invalid output, wrong requested fact, or material unsupported claim

real-dev-a-projection: learned nonlinear projection compared with a linear projection
more than 10% improvement over no projection head
evaluation uses the representation before the projection head
real-dev-b-temperature-parameter: one learned scalar parameter shared across all classes
real-dev-b-reuters-exception: low initial calibration error or already well-calibrated predictions

grading: Inspect the full answer and cited source content; lexical markers alone are insufficient. Reference labels are development-only.

references.real-dev-a-default-augmentation-en: The defaults are random crop and resize with random flip, color distortions, and Gaussian blur.
references.real-dev-a-default-augmentation-ko: 기본 증강은 무작위 자르기와 크기 조정 및 무작위 뒤집기, 색상 왜곡, 가우시안 블러입니다.
references.real-dev-a-projection-en: Nonlinear projection performs about 3% better than linear projection and more than 10% better than no projection in this ablation.
references.real-dev-a-projection-ko: 이 제거 실험에서 비선형 투영은 선형 투영보다 약 3% 높고 투영 없는 경우보다 10% 넘게 높았습니다.
references.real-dev-b-temperature-parameter-en: Temperature scaling uses one shared scalar parameter T for all classes, with T greater than zero.
references.real-dev-b-temperature-parameter-ko: 온도 보정은 모든 클래스가 공유하는 스칼라 매개변수 T 하나를 사용하며 T는 0보다 커야 합니다.
references.real-dev-b-reuters-exception-en: Reuters is the exception. It is already well calibrated with ECE at or below 1%, leaving little room for improvement.
references.real-dev-b-reuters-exception-ko: 예외는 Reuters이며 이미 ECE가 1% 이하로 잘 보정되어 있어 개선 여지가 적었습니다.
